identification: Plume & Atwood 'Royal' centre-draught kerosene table lamp, American, about 1890-1910: nickel-plated brass bulbous font on a pierced foot, side wick-winder knob with a rosette, Royal centre-draught burner with perforated gallery and four chimney prongs, plain clear glass chimney, no shade. Flame spreader is stamped 'P ROYAL A' (P&A for Plume & Atwood) with a sunburst. 44 cm with chimney. Wear to the plating. Cloud scan correct.
